description: Phase 2 exit-criteria thresholds for dispatch recommendation latency gate (WO-206).
comment: comparator must be one of: <=, <, >=, >. Boundary values are evaluated inclusively for <= and >=.

thresholds.rationale: Stakeholder-committed 3-second p95 budget for recommendation endpoint
Tail-latency guard to catch individual extreme outliers
Median well below the p95 budget to ensure normal-path is fast
Server error rate must stay below 1% under load
Work-order creation should not degrade under recommendation load
Travel-provider call timeout is 1500ms; p95 must fit within it
